# Cowork / no-bash adaptations

Read this **only** when bash / Playwright are unavailable (Cowork, sandboxed
read-only FS). **The kit-enforcement invariants are environment-independent** —
only the access mechanics change. In bash environments use the fast paths in
SKILL.md (`materialize-deck.sh`, `verify-deck-headless.py`) and ignore this file.

## 1. Kit access

Use Step 0 Path B (Read tool on the three CSS files). The bundled kit lives at
`<skill-dir>/kit-corporate/` — the same place the bash probe finds it. There is
no separate "Cowork kit": same files, different access mechanism.

## 2. Slide materialization (no `materialize-deck.sh`)

Write each slide's HTML manually: pick a template via `kit-map.md § 5 catalog`
(+ § 7 chooser), Read it from `kit-corporate/templates/`, copy the structure,
replace the text. Use one of two link forms — whichever resolves from the deck
folder back to the bundled kit:

**Form 1 — link to the bundled kit** (preferred when relative paths work;
assumes `tmp/decks/<deck>/slide-NN.html` is three levels below the kit):

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="../../../kit-corporate/shared/tokens.css" />
<link rel="stylesheet" href="../../../kit-corporate/shared/layouts.css" />
<link rel="stylesheet" href="../../../kit-corporate/shared/components.css" />
```

**Form 2 — self-contained copy** (fallback when `../../../` can't reach the kit):
copy the **ENTIRE** `kit-corporate/` directory verbatim into
`tmp/decks/<deck>/kit-corporate/` (`cp -R`, or Read+Write every file) and link
relatively (`href="kit-corporate/shared/tokens.css"`).

> **CRITICAL — copy `assets/` too, not just `shared/`.** `layouts.css`
> references the backgrounds as `url(../assets/backgrounds/*.jpg)` (resolved
> relative to the CSS). If you copy only `shared/`, EVERY background (and every
> icon / logo / graphic) 404s and the deck renders with blank backgrounds — a
> real failure that shipped once. Copy `shared/` **and** `assets/` (backgrounds,
> icons, logo, graphics, chapter). The headless verifier's `asset_404` gate
> catches a partial copy, but don't rely on it — copy the whole kit.

No edits / merges / inlining — the substitution gate keys on the `/shared/`
segment, not the `../../../` prefix. Record the choice in `kit_path_resolved`.

**Never** substitute with a Tailwind CDN, inline `<style>` > 200 chars, an
arbitrary CSS framework, or a "merged" kit. The self-contained copy is the same
kit relocated, not a substitution.

## 3. Verification (no `verify-deck-headless.py`)

Per slide, run `scripts/verify-slide.sh <slide-file>` → paste the emitted JS
into Claude Preview `preview_eval` → read the JSON report; then
`preview_screenshot` to eyeball it. (Same `slide-checks.js` logic as the headless
path.) If even bash can't emit the snippet, walk each slide manually and confirm:
all three kit stylesheets linked · no external CDN `<link>`s · no `<style>` > 200
chars · no em dash `—` in copy · positions per `composition-rules.md`. Record as
`evidence: 'manual walkthrough — bash unavailable'` in `self_check.gates_checked[]`.

## 4. PPTX export (no local toolchain)

See `references/pptx-export.md § Cowork`. Offer the user: (a) run the export in
Codex, (b) install `python-pptx`+`playwright` once, or (c) skip pptx
(HTML only). This is Checkpoint #1's routing; block on the answer.

The Step 9c self-check trace is emitted regardless of path — bash availability
changes mechanics, not invariants.
